title: VHDLBench: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for VHDL-Based Chip Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.28676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid evolution of digital circuit complexity demands innovative approaches to hardware design automation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have influenced software development, their application to Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation remains largely unexplored, particularly for VHDL. This paper presents a comprehensive study for AI-assisted digital circuit design, addressing gaps in current Electronic Design Automation workflows. The work introduces a VHDL dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified examples from open-source repositories and converted Verilog designs. Five 7B-parameter LLMs were fine-tuned using parameter-efficient QLoRA technique, enabling deployment in resource-constrained environments. To evaluate model efficacy, a rigorous three-level pipeline was established: (1) syntax and synthesis validation, (2) functional simulation with testbenches, and (3) FPGA prototyping on Zynq SoCs. Results show fine-tuned mode

translated_title: VHDLBench：面向基于VHDL芯片设计的大语言模型基准测试与微调
translated_abstract: 数字电路复杂性的快速演进对硬件设计自动化的创新方法提出了迫切需求。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已对软件开发产生了深远影响，但其在硬件描述语言（HDL）生成方面的应用在很大程度上仍未被探索，尤其是针对VHDL。本文提出了一项关于AI辅助数字电路设计的综合性研究，填补了当前电子设计自动化（EDA）工作流程中的空白。这项工作引入了一个包含18,500多个经语法验证示例的VHDL数据集，这些示例来自开源代码库以及由Verilog设计转换而来的代码。研究采用参数高效的QLoRA技术对五个70亿参数的大语言模型进行了微调，使其能够在资源受限的环境中部署。为评估模型效能，研究建立了一套严格的三级评估流程：（1）语法与综合验证，（2）基于测试平台的仿真，（3）在Zynq SoC上进行FPGA原型验证。结果显示，微调后的模型……
tldr: 本文提出VHDLBench基准，构建了包含18,500多个经语法验证样本的VHDL数据集，采用QLoRA微调五个7B参数大语言模型，并建立了涵盖语法综合验证、功能仿真到Zynq SoC上FPGA原型验证的三级严格评估流程，推动大语言模型在VHDL芯片设计自动化中的应用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VHDLBench, featuring a dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified VHDL examples and QLoRA fine-tuning of five 7B-parameter LLMs, evaluated through a rigorous three-level pipeline spanning syntax/synthesis validation, functional simulation with testbenches, and FPGA prototyping on Zynq SoCs for VHDL-based chip design.
